description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, causes [Imperil Earth 20% (25s)], grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Guy II)], and [Earth Resonance +5% Boost] to the user
Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Guy II): Earth Ability Boost, Triplecast Earth & chases Earth abilities with 4 single attacks (0.60 each)

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text:
Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Earth Mode II (Guy II)] to the user
Dual Awoken Earth Mode II (Guy II): Earth Ability Boost, Instant Earth & chases an Earth ability with causes [DEF, RES and MND -50% (8s)] and grants [Earth +40% Boost (5s)] to all allies
